# Materiales

Los datos fisicoquímicos provienen de múltiples fuentes: [Aguas de Corrientes](https://www.aguasdecorrientes.com/), [SAMEEP](https://sameep.gob.ar/) y APA.

## APA

La **Administración Provincial del Agua** de la provincia del Chaco colaboró con datos de muestreos realizados en campañas en el 2024 y 2025.

```{r}
#| column: screen-inset-shaded
library(leaflet)
p <- read.table("datos/coordenadas_APA.txt", sep = "\t", header = TRUE) |>
  sf::st_as_sf(coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326)

leaflet(data = p) |>
  addMarkers(
    label = ~sitio,
    icon = icons(
      iconUrl = "img/f7--drop-fill.png",
      iconWidth = 30,
      iconHeight = 30
    )
  ) |>
  addTiles(group = "OSM") |>
  addTiles(
    urlTemplate = "https://server.arcgisonline.com/ArcGIS/rest/services/World_Imagery/MapServer/tile/{z}/{y}/{x}",
    group = "ESRI"
  ) |>
  leafem::addLogo(
    img = "img/logo_gistaq.png",
    position = "bottomleft",
    width = 152,
    height = 50
  ) |>
  addLayersControl(baseGroups = c("OSM", "ESRI")) |>
  leaflet.extras::addResetMapButton() |>
  leaflet.extras::addFullscreenControl(position = "bottomright")
```
